title: CapabilityVectorCaptureSlot
description: DD-124(1): the closed observation slots a CAPTURE may take. CONTENT_REFERENCE_* read the adapter's typed ContentReference; GENERATED_REF reads an output field listed in the vector document's generatedRefs; ACTION_EXECUTION_ID/OPERATION_ID are the SOURCE read ActionExecution and Operation the isolated Core generated for a step of a RECEIVER case in this run (never present in the plan or fixture).
